subtitle: Amapuzzle e-binary ansuku
description: Dlala ipuzzle yansuku zonke ye-Takuzu ye-4×4 noma amabhodi amahhala e-4×4 nawe-6×6. Imigqa namakholomu kumelwe kulingane, kungabi khona izinombolo ezintathu ezifanayo ngokulandelana, futhi ungaphindi ukhiqize imigqa egcwele efanayo. Sebenzisa izeluleko, hlehlisa, phinda, futhi uqale kabusha. Inqubekelaphambili igcinwa endaweni.
